A TC11 alloy plate with a thickness of 4 mm was used as the raw material in this study.

Diffusion bonding was performed in a vacuum furnace (ZT-40-21Y). The diffusion bonding temperatures were 750 8C and 780 8C for the UIT samples and 750 8C, 780 8C, 800 8C, and 820 8C for the non-UIT samples. The holding time was 30 min at a pressure of 10 MPa.

UIT of the TC11 plate was conducted in ambient atmosphere. The frequency of the gun was approximately 18 KHz. The current was 2.5 A, corresponding to 25 mm of the vibrational amplitude.
